   <div id="docSubImgWrapper" data-setting="userPref-viewMode-pub-sjj-systemPreferred-html">
      
         
            <div id="docSubImgHTML" class="docSubContent current " data-show-on-open=".jsHideForDocSubVideo">
               
                  <div class="textSizeIncrement">

<p id="p3" data-pid="3" class="themeScrp">(<a class=" jsBibleLink" data-bible="nwtsty" data-requested-bible="" data-targetverses="19091001-19091016" href="/en/library/bible/study-bible/books/psalms/91/#v19091001-v19091016" target="_blank">Psalm 91</a>)</p>
<div class="bodyTxt">
<ol class="source">
<li>
<p id="p4" data-pid="4" class="p4 sl"><span class="txtSrcBullet">1. </span>Jehovah is our refuge,</p>
<p id="p5" data-pid="5" class="p5 sz">Our God in whom we trust.</p>
<p id="p6" data-pid="6" class="p6 sp">His shadow is our shelter;</p>
<p id="p7" data-pid="7" class="p7 sz">Remain in it we must.</p>
<p id="p8" data-pid="8" class="p8 sp">His faithful ones he will defend,</p>
<p id="p9" data-pid="9" class="p9 sz">On this we know we can depend.</p>
<p id="p10" data-pid="10" class="p10 sp">Jehovah is a stronghold,</p>
<p id="p11" data-pid="11" class="p11 sz">Ever faithful, loyal, and just.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p id="p12" data-pid="12" class="p12 sl"><span class="txtSrcBullet">2. </span>Though thousands will have fallen</p>
<p id="p13" data-pid="13" class="p13 sz">And many at our side,</p>
<p id="p14" data-pid="14" class="p14 sp">The righteous and the meek ones</p>
<p id="p15" data-pid="15" class="p15 sz">Will never be denied.</p>
<p id="p16" data-pid="16" class="p16 sp">So in our hearts we need not fear;</p>
<p id="p17" data-pid="17" class="p17 sz">Calamity will not come near.</p>
<p id="p18" data-pid="18" class="p18 sp">From danger he will shield us,</p>
<p id="p19" data-pid="19" class="p19 sz">For beneath God’s wings we’ll reside.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p id="p20" data-pid="20" class="p20 sl"><span class="txtSrcBullet">3. </span>He’ll keep us and protect us</p>
<p id="p21" data-pid="21" class="p21 sz">From snares along our way,</p>
<p id="p22" data-pid="22" class="p22 sp">From terrors in the nighttime,</p>
<p id="p23" data-pid="23" class="p23 sz">And arrows by the day.</p>
<p id="p24" data-pid="24" class="p24 sp">Yes, there will be no cause for dread,</p>
<p id="p25" data-pid="25" class="p25 sz">No place where we will fear to tread.</p>
<p id="p26" data-pid="26" class="p26 sp">Jehovah is our refuge,</p>
<p id="p27" data-pid="27" class="p27 sz">Ever guarding us on our way.</p>
</li>
</ol>
</div>
<div class="closingContent">
<p id="p28" data-pid="28" class="p28 se">(See also <a class=" jsBibleLink" data-bible="nwtsty" data-requested-bible="" data-targetverses="19097010" href="/en/library/bible/study-bible/books/psalms/97/#v19097010" target="_blank">Ps. 97:10;</a><a class=" jsBibleLink" data-bible="nwtsty" data-requested-bible="" data-targetverses="19121003" href="/en/library/bible/study-bible/books/psalms/121/#v19121003" target="_blank"> 121:3,</a><a class=" jsBibleLink" data-bible="nwtsty" data-requested-bible="" data-targetverses="19121005" href="/en/library/bible/study-bible/books/psalms/121/#v19121005" target="_blank"> 5;</a><a class=" jsBibleLink" data-bible="nwtsty" data-requested-bible="" data-targetverses="23052012" href="/en/library/bible/study-bible/books/isaiah/52/#v23052012" target="_blank"> Isa. 52:12</a>.)</p>
</div>
<p id="p29" class="displayNone"> </p>
